informative_blocks.title: Liquidity Pulse
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Rising DXY and higher real yields crush risk appetite and compress price action.
• Institutional flows slow sharply when USD funding conditions tighten.
• Low 1-hour volume relative to average signals buyer exhaustion.

**ETH:**
• ETH suffers amplified downside as a high-beta asset during liquidity squeezes.
• L2 activity becomes secondary when stablecoin supply flattens.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If DXY declines sharply while BTC spot volume surges more than 20% intraday, the bearish liquidity pressure is invalidated and a relief rally becomes likely.

informative_blocks.title: Cross-Asset Wiring
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Bear flattening of the UST 2y/10y curve often precedes aggressive risk-off selling.
• Rising 2-year yields during NY open frequently trigger immediate weakness.

**ETH:**
• ETH lags significantly when equities rally despite higher yields.
• Price correlates heavily to NASDAQ when High Yield spreads widen.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If BTC breaks resistance with strong volume despite surging DXY and yields, the macro correlation has broken and a pure crypto-driven regime begins.

informative_blocks.title: Funding & Positioning
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Rising price with rising OI and positive funding signals late-long risk.
• Falling price with rising OI indicates building liquidation pressure.

**ETH:**
• Deep negative funding in a tight range often traps retail shorts and fuels violent squeezes.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If price continues lower despite deeply negative funding and declining OI, there is no trapped leverage left — it is genuine spot capitulation.

informative_blocks.title: BTC Structure Map
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Losing a defended swing low with volume expansion confirms trend continuation.
• Prior weekly range highs flip to strong support during confirmed breakouts.

**ETH:**
• Price reacts more reliably to high-timeframe inefficiencies (FVGs) than random entries.
• VWAP clusters from prior impulse legs act as strong intraday magnets.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a broken swing low is immediately reclaimed with aggressive volume, the breakdown was a liquidity trap and a violent reversal is likely.

informative_blocks.title: ETH / L2 Beta
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Dominates capital flows and acts as the main liquidity sponge during risk-off events.

**ETH:**
• Rising ETH/BTC ratio gives permission to hunt higher-beta altcoins.
• Major network upgrades create high-volatility windows where risk management is critical.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If ETH breaks down sharply against BTC despite successful upgrades and strong L2 activity, the beta thesis is broken.

informative_blocks.title: Volatility Regimes
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• ATR collapse before major news events often acts as a coiled spring for the next trend.
• True breakouts require multiple 4H closes above the level, not just a wick.

**ETH:**
• High vol-of-vol frequently destroys tight stops during compression phases.
• ATR expansion after a long balance area provides strong trend fuel.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If volatility spikes violently but immediately collapses back into the prior range, the expansion thesis fails and chop resumes.

informative_blocks.title: Policy & Data Week
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Major prints like CPI and FOMC typically trigger an initial stop-run before the real move.
• The 2-year yield reaction post-print reveals the market’s true interpretation.

**ETH:**
• High beta makes holding positions through the print extremely risky.
• Liquidity dries up sharply in the minutes before scheduled data.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a major data surprise triggers an immediate unidirectional trend with no initial stop-run, fading the move becomes highly dangerous.

informative_blocks.title: On-Chain Flow Hints
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Persistent exchange outflows during uptrends often signal institutional accumulation.
• Large inflows during vertical rallies frequently precede distribution.

**ETH:**
• Whale transfers to exchanges near resistance zones indicate distribution risk.
• Stablecoin mint/burn trends help gauge available global dry powder.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If massive inflows occur but price continues higher on strong spot volume, demand is absorbing all selling pressure.

informative_blocks.title: Scenario Grid
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Holding cash is optimal during sudden risk-off shocks until forced selling clears.
• Buy pullbacks strictly at broken resistance-turned-support during melt-up scenarios.

**ETH:**
• Fade extreme price deviations inside the established range until a higher timeframe break occurs.
• Weekly probability shifts dictate your maximum risk cap.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If an unpriced systemic black swan occurs, the base-case scenario grid is immediately voided and capital preservation becomes the only objective.

informative_blocks.title: Order Flow Microstructure
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Repeated aggressive absorption at a level confirms institutional defense.
• Aggressive buyers lifting offers into resistance that holds signals hidden supply.

**ETH:**
• Iceberg and reload behavior near resistance indicates heavy hidden supply.
• Thin books amplify wicks and create frequent fakeouts.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If aggressive buyers lift offers at resistance and price breaks cleanly with sustained volume, the supply thesis is crushed and a new trend initiates.

informative_blocks.title: Breadth & Rotation
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Rising BTC dominance during a rally shows capital is defensive and selective.
• Broad risk appetite returns only when BTC dominance falls sharply.

**ETH:**
• ETH leads the rotation into altcoins when market breadth expands.
• Failed leaders that cannot make new highs on BTC strength are early exit signals.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If the entire crypto board turns green on extremely low volume, the rotation is a fakeout driven by short-covering.

informative_blocks.title: Risk Budgeting
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Limit risk on news events and scale up only when higher-timeframe structure is clear.
• Acts as the safest core holding when correlations spike toward 1.0.

**ETH:**
• Requires smaller position sizing due to higher volatility.
• Daily maximum loss limits should physically force you off the screens.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If diversification fails during a severe liquidity crash, gross exposure must be reduced before stress, not during.

informative_blocks.title: Narrative Lifecycles
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Anchors the macro liquidity cycle and ignores micro-narratives.
• Serves as the benchmark to measure if a narrative is truly outperforming.

**ETH:**
• Highly vulnerable to distribution when social velocity peaks and funding rates go parabolic.
• Narrative tokens without chart structure become lottery tickets.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a narrative token pumps violently on declining volume while BTC dumps, the divergence is unsustainable.

informative_blocks.title: Session Playbook
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Asia sets the initial range, London tests liquidity, and NY forces expansion or reversion.
• Local highs and lows from prior sessions act as strong intraday magnets.

**ETH:**
• Highly sensitive to the NY equity open.
• End-of-month flows create artificial trends that ignore technicals.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a major geopolitical headline hits during the illiquid Asia session, all standard session rules are invalidated.

informative_blocks.title: Tail Risk Triggers
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Banking stress and sudden FX peg breaks propagate to crypto in hours.
• Correlation to NASDAQ spikes heavily during fear events.

**ETH:**
• Options skew and crash protection pricing telegraph institutional fear early.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a major regional bank collapses but BTC rallies on high volume, the flight-to-safety narrative overrides standard risk-off correlation.

informative_blocks.title: Perp Basis Edge Cases
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Extreme contango during flat spot price action warns of leverage imbalance.
• Basis inversion during volatility events signals late arbitrage action.

**ETH:**
• Use extreme basis only as a warning light for crowded leverage.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If spot price trends through an extreme basis dislocation without triggering liquidations, spot flow has overpowered the leverage trap.

informative_blocks.title: Backtest Honesty
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Trend strategies that worked in 2021 fail completely in 2024 ranges.
• Walk-forward testing must include realistic fees and slippage.

**ETH:**
• Simple structural rules survive regime shifts better than complex indicators.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a historically profitable strategy suffers a 50% drawdown in live markets, the current regime has shifted and the edge is dead.

informative_blocks.title: Levels That Matter
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• A level is only valid if it changes behavior at least twice.
• The third reaction provides actionable data; the first is speculation.

**ETH:**
• Confluence of prior highs, VWAP, and option walls beats random lines.
• Price often seeks liquidity pools slightly beyond obvious stops.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a multi-touch level is broken and held for a full 4H session, the level is officially dead.

informative_blocks.title: Stablecoin Stress Signals
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• A major stablecoin depeg rumor triggers immediate risk-off selling.
• BTC acts as the primary safe haven during stablecoin panics.

**ETH:**
• Liquidity evaporates rapidly as stable pools rebalance.
• On-chain swap slippage reveals the true bid/ask during stress.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a stablecoin depegs slightly but fiat on-ramps aggressively bid BTC, the panic is localized.

informative_blocks.title: Cognitive Traps
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Loss aversion delays cutting losing breakdown trades.
• Confirmation bias makes you see bullish patterns in random noise.

**ETH:**
• Recency bias overweights your last volatile altcoin outcome.
• Pre-define invalidation before entry to prevent emotional negotiation.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If you manually override a valid algorithmic stop based on gut feeling, your risk management is invalidated.

informative_blocks.title: News Velocity
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• If price does not immediately confirm a bullish headline, the news is already priced in.
• Trade the structural reaction, never the morality of the headline.

**ETH:**
• Thin weekend books amplify fakeouts from unverified news.
• Verify secondary sources before reacting to exchange incidents.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a catastrophic headline drops but price bounces off support with massive volume, the bottom is in.

informative_blocks.title: Mean Reversion vs Trend
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Buy pullbacks in confirmed trends; sell rips in ranges.
• Identify the regime before applying your strategy.

**ETH:**
• Mixing trend and range rules is how accounts bleed slowly.
• Intraday shorts are scalps only if the weekly is bullish.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If price violently breaks the range and sustains above it, mean-reversion is dead and trend rules apply.

informative_blocks.title: Sizing & Convexity
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Linear spot with tight stops allows larger notional size with the same risk.
• Adding to winners compounds edge in sustained trends.

**ETH:**
• Convex payoffs require significantly smaller nominal sizing.
• Averaging losers only works in confirmed mean-reversion regimes.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If you size up a high-beta altcoin to match BTC spot size, a standard wick can trigger catastrophic drawdown.

informative_blocks.title: FX & Carry Spillovers
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• A surging USD tightens global conditions and suppresses price action.
• Divergences between DXY and real yields usually resolve violently.

**ETH:**
• Vulnerable to emerging market stress that ripples into risk assets.
• EUR and CNH moves often flag liquidity shifts early.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If BTC ignores a massive DXY breakout and continues higher, it has decoupled from traditional FX drivers.

informative_blocks.title: ETF & Passive Flows
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Sustained ETF inflows on down days signal strong accumulation.
• Compare flow magnitude to realized spot volume.

**ETH:**
• Follows BTC ETF narratives but with delayed beta.
• Arbitrage desks close temporary premiums or discounts quickly.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If record ETF inflows occur at a local top, the flows were exit liquidity for smart money.

informative_blocks.title: Correlation Breaks
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• When correlation to NASDAQ drops, BTC trades on idiosyncratic catalysts.
• Rising correlation in crashes proves macro overrides all crypto charts.

**ETH:**
• Regulatory or protocol events can force complete decoupling from BTC.
• Track 30-day rolling correlation to spot regime shifts.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a crypto-specific regulatory ban occurs, BTC and ETH will crash independently of traditional markets.

informative_blocks.title: Execution Quality
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Use limit orders in ranges; market orders only when speed is critical.
• Avoid major entries during the exact minute of CPI prints.

**ETH:**
• Slippage destroys small edges in high-frequency strategies.
• Check per-exchange spread versus your trade size.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If you experience >1% slippage during normal hours, your execution routing is flawed.

informative_blocks.title: DeFi Liquidity Cliffs
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Largely insulated from smart contract and oracle risks.

**ETH:**
• Directly exposed to oracle gaps and stable pool stress.
• Incentivized yields attract mercenary capital that dumps quickly.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a major DeFi protocol is hacked but ETH spot holds key support, the contagion has been siloed.

informative_blocks.title: Halving & Cycle Myths
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Narrative hype consistently front-runs the actual supply shock.
• The marginal buyer and seller set the price, not just miner issuance.

**ETH:**
• Extrapolating past cycles ignores massive structural changes from ETFs.
• Cycle talk is best used as a sentiment gauge.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a global recession overlaps with the halving year, the expected supply shock pump will fail.

informative_blocks.title: Confluence Scoring
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Rate setups 1–5 based on trend alignment, key level, volume, macro, and clear invalidation.
• Trade A+ setups at full size; skip C setups entirely.

**ETH:**
• B-tier setups require reduced sizing; C-tier setups are journal-only.
• A strict scoring system beats indicator soup.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If you execute a perfectly scored A+ setup but ignore a looming macro event, the technical confluence is invalidated.

informative_blocks.title: Momentum Quality
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Momentum on rising volume and expanding ranges sustains the trend.
• Momentum on falling volume is exhausted and prone to mean-reversion.

**ETH:**
• Climactic candles without follow-through are exhaustion traps.
• Relative strength leaders in the first NY hour usually persist.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a low-volume breakout suddenly gains massive institutional backing, the initial fakeout thesis is wrong.

informative_blocks.title: Drawdown Psychology
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Expectancy and R-multiples matter more than high win rate.
• A 40% win rate with 3:1 R beats a 70% win rate with 0.5:1 R.

**ETH:**
• Increasing risk to recover a loss is the fastest path to ruin.
• Return to minimum size until statistics recover.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If you abandon sizing rules to revenge-trade, a second loss will push the account past recovery.

informative_blocks.title: Tax & Reporting Hygiene
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Year-end forced selling creates predictable downward pressure.
• Wash-sale rules differ by jurisdiction and can ruin net profit.

**ETH:**
• Staking and DeFi yields heavily complicate tax liabilities.
• Record timestamps, fees, and counterparties manually.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If you execute a 50% gain but ignore short-term capital gains tax, your actual return is severely reduced.

informative_blocks.title: Infra & Exchange Risk
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Self-custody removes exchange risk but adds key management risk.
• Proof-of-Reserves is marketing unless liabilities are fully detailed.

**ETH:**
• API failures and withdrawal queues are major operational risks.
• Split balances across venues to survive isolated outages.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If a tier-1 exchange halts API access during volatility, your automated stops become useless.

informative_blocks.title: Social Layer Noise
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Consensus peaks in Discord or Telegram are reliable contrarian signals.
• Curate inputs ruthlessly; a strict information diet is an edge.

**ETH:**
• High engagement farming correlates strongly with bad calls.
• When everyone agrees, ask who is left to buy.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If retail consensus is correct and price continues higher, fading the crowd will result in fighting a sustained trend.

informative_blocks.title: Next Week's Tripwires
informative_blocks.content:
**BTC:**
• Rank scheduled prints by historical sensitivity and reduce leverage beforehand.
• Pre-plan responses: reduce, hedge, or accept gap risk.

**ETH:**
• Mark token unlocks, court rulings, and protocol upgrades on a calendar.
• Reserve mental bandwidth for true black swans.

**Stress-test / Invalidation:**
If an unscheduled black swan hits, your planned tripwire calendar is useless and immediate risk reduction is required.

free_analysis.title: Risk in One Line
free_analysis.content:
Never risk more than 1–2% of your total account equity on any single trade.

Survival comes first — your edge needs time to compound.

free_analysis.title: R:R Without the Math Fog
free_analysis.content:
Aim for at least 2:1 reward-to-risk on every setup.

If you can’t clearly see 2:1 with a logical invalidation, the trade isn’t worth taking.

free_analysis.title: Why Liquidity Hunts Happen
free_analysis.content:
Price frequently wicks past obvious highs and lows to trigger retail stops before the real move.

This is not random — it is how the market hunts liquidity.

free_analysis.title: Higher Timeframe Filter
free_analysis.content:
If your 15-minute trade goes against the daily bias, you are fighting the bigger trend.

Align timeframes or reduce size dramatically.

free_analysis.title: RSI: Beyond 30/70
free_analysis.content:
Oversold can stay oversold in strong downtrends.
Overbought can stay overbought in strong uptrends.

Context always beats a single number.

free_analysis.title: Volume Tells the Truth
free_analysis.content:
Breakouts on weak volume are usually fakeouts.
Real moves show strong participation.

Always compare volume to recent averages.

free_analysis.title: Stop Placement Basics
free_analysis.content:
Place stops beyond structure, never at obvious round numbers.

Tighter stops are not smarter if they get hit by normal noise.

free_analysis.title: Plan the Trade
free_analysis.content:
Write your entry, invalidation, and target before you click.

If you won’t write the plan, you won’t respect it when the trade moves against you.

free_analysis.title: Trend vs Range Mode
free_analysis.content:
Different market regimes require different rules.
Ranges reward fades. Trends reward pullbacks.

Mixing the two is how accounts die slowly.

free_analysis.title: Noise Control
free_analysis.content:
Most chart hours offer zero edge.

Trade only your high-probability windows and ignore the rest.

free_analysis.title: Fees Are Friction
free_analysis.content:
If your strategy needs 0.3% just to break even, scalping is mathematical suicide.

Know your exact round-trip cost before trading.

free_analysis.title: Support/Resistance That Sticks
free_analysis.content:
A level only matters if it has been respected multiple times with volume.

Arbitrary lines drawn on a chart mean nothing.

free_analysis.title: Leverage Is Optional
free_analysis.content:
1× with a solid plan beats 10× with hope.

Leverage multiplies mistakes, not intelligence.

free_analysis.title: Journal One Thing
free_analysis.content:
After every trade, log your reason, your emotion, and the result.

Patterns about your psychology appear faster than you expect.

free_analysis.title: What Premium Actually Buys
free_analysis.content:
Premium is not about promises.
It is about timely context, validated signals, deeper coverage, and less time decoding noise.
